items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And I looked over there and sitting on the couch was Marshall Royal... I looked at Marshall and I said now here's a great saxophone player... I said this to Marshall

ctx.x: What year are we talking about now?

We're talking about 1945, '44 or '45. Yes. But I was still in the army, and Vernon was in the navy, and I would go over to St. Mary's where Vernon was. You know who had the band, Marshall Royal. Tremendous band.
